notes: Squeek Wars Testnet on Sepolia (11155111). Deploy these five accepted application contracts in the listed dependency order in one factory transaction. GameRules supplies immutable economy tables; SeedLedger records daily work checkpoints and nontransferable SEED balances; Clans tracks membership and rankings; Army handles troops, movements, combat, champions and camps; Villages is the canonical player entry point and helper-module namespace. Army and Villages share the same GameRules, SeedLedger and Clans instances. SeedLedger alone has an owner: $owner resolves to the paying wallet. Its authority is proposing, applying or cancelling a 72-hour timelocked repoint of the Core and NFT read endpoints, or renouncing ownership. The initial SqueekCore and Squeek ERC-721 addresses are unchanged. Constructors are nonpayable and require no initialization calls. No launch token, pool, reward distributor or ETH funding. The accepted size adaptation and local validation are recorded in docs/VALIDATION.md: runtime bytes are GameRules 4225, SeedLedger 5770, Clans 5084, Army 19199 and Villages 17090, totaling 51368 (below 52000). Estimated launch gas is 89870111 (below 90000000), modeling 1700 gas per runtime byte and including a 500000-gas factory allowance. This is a local estimate; independent review and deployment-service preflight against the actual factory and current Sepolia gas schedule remain required.
